How Often Should You Use a Sauna?

Most people do well with 2 to 3 sauna sessions a week. In long-running Finnish studies, men who used a sauna 4 to 7 times a week had the lowest rates of fatal heart disease, dementia, stroke and high blood pressure. Those are associations, not proof, and beginners should build up from one or two sessions.
